title: Augmented Analytics & the Petabyte knowledge graph (in your Enterprise already). Giovanni Tummarello
description:
Graph Databases are amazing, but the “Knowledge Graph” is actually within the data itself, most of which already resides in big enterprise back ends (or no SQL systems) which can store Petabytes of data. Augmented Analytics is a term by which Gartner defines new tools which are capable of leveraging AI (in broad sense) to provide value.

In this presentation i’ll put the two together introducing Siren, an Augmented Analytics / “Investigative Intelligence” platform which can connect to traditional backends and make them  accessible as a knowledge graph as well as leverage GraphDBs.  The platform then provides AI capabilities to discover connections automatically among records, applicable in many high value use cases.

Keynote in Connected Data London 2019.
